headlines.title: Growth in China’s factory-gate prices accelerates, but consumer inflation subdued
headlines.summary:
Growth in Chinese factory-gate prices continued to accelerate last month, while consumer price growth remained subdued despite Beijing’s efforts to shore up domestic demand and support the economy in meeting its annual growth target.
The producer price index (PPI) rose 5 per cent year on year in September, the highest rate since mid-2022, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Wednesday. It rose by 3.8 per cent in August.

headlines.title_zh: 中国工业生产者出厂价格涨幅加快，但消费者通胀低迷
headlines.summary_zh:
中国出厂价格上月继续加速上涨，而尽管北京方面努力提振国内需求并支持经济实现年度增长目标，消费者价格涨幅仍保持低迷。
数据显示，9月份生产者价格指数（PPI）同比上涨5%，为2022年年中以来的最高水平。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng meets with central bank governors of relevant countries
headlines.summary_en: From October 14 to 16, 2026, during his attendance at the IMF/World Bank Annual Meetings, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng met separately with Bank of Thailand Governor Vitai, Bank Indonesia Governor Destry, Bank Negara Malaysia Governor Rasheed, Reserve Bank of India Governor Malhotra, Reserve Bank of Australia Governor Bullock, Central Bank of Turkey Governor Karahan, Central Bank of Egypt Governor Abdallah, Central Bank of Nigeria Governor Cardoso, National Bank of Georgia Governor Turnava and other central bank governors of relevant countries, and exchanged views on topics including the global economic situation and deepening bilateral practical financial cooperation. headlines.title: 中国人民银行行长潘功胜出席第54届国际货币与金融委员会会议
headlines.summary: 2026年10月16日至17日，国际货币基金组织在泰国曼谷召开第54届国际货币与金融委员会（IMFC）会议，会议讨论了全球经济金融形势、基金组织工作等议题。中国人民银行行长潘功胜指出，贸易摩擦和保护主义通过影响供应链、推升通胀、扰乱市场预期等因素拖累全球经济。同时，新一轮科技革命和产业变革加速突破，既蕴含巨大机遇，也面临治理挑战。各国应加强政策协同，降低经营主体面临的不确定性，坚定支持多边贸易体制，抵制一切形式的保护主义措施。中方愿继续深化与基金组织的合作，共同维护全球经济金融稳定。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng attends the 54th IMFC meeting
headlines.summary_en: From October 16 to 17, 2026, the International Monetary Fund held the 54th meeting of the International Monetary and Financial Committee (IMFC) in Bangkok, Thailand. The meeting discussed the global economic and financial situation, the work of the Fund and other topics. PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng pointed out that trade frictions and protectionism weigh on the global economy by affecting supply chains, pushing up inflation and disrupting market expectations. At the same time, a new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation is accelerating, embodying both enormous opportunities and governance challenges. Countries should strengthen policy coordination, reduce the uncertainty facing business entities, firmly support the multilateral trading system and resist protectionist measures in all forms. China is willing to continue deepening cooperation with the Fund and jointly safeguard global economic and financial stability.

headlines.title: 多方判断电价拐点已现
headlines.summary: 进入四季度，电力市场淡季不淡。在迎峰度夏结束、高温负荷逐步消退的背景下，广东、江苏等地月度交易电价不降反升，南方区域现货价格亦持续走强。此外，10月13日，江苏电力交易中心印发《2027年江苏电力零售市场交易工作指引》，推动批零价格全面传导。行业专家表示，本轮电价上涨是供需两端多重因素叠加的结果，属于市场运行中的合理波动；江苏新版规则为电价向用户侧传导提供了机制样本。多名券商公用事业研究员判断，2026年或是国内电价底部，拐点正在显现。（上海证券报）

headlines.title_en: Multiple parties judge that the electricity price turning point has emerged
headlines.summary_en: Entering the fourth quarter, the power market is not sluggish in the off-season. Against the backdrop of the end of peak summer demand and the gradual fading of high-temperature loads, monthly trading electricity prices in Guangdong, Jiangsu and other places have risen rather than fallen, and spot prices in the southern region have also continued to strengthen. In addition, on October 13, the Jiangsu Power Exchange Center issued the "2027 Jiangsu Power Retail Market Trading Work Guidelines" to promote the full transmission of wholesale and retail prices. Industry experts said this round of electricity price increases is the result of multiple factors on both the supply and demand sides and is a reasonable fluctuation in market operation; Jiangsu's new rules provide a mechanism example for transmitting electricity prices to the user side. Several brokerage utility researchers judge that 2026 may be the bottom of domestic electricity prices, and a turning point is emerging. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 英媒报道：英国顶住欧盟施压拒对中国车加税
headlines.summary: 英国商业、创新、科学和贸易大臣乔纳森·雷诺兹驳斥了欧盟要求英国对中国商品加征关税的主张。他表示，英国政府不会因布鲁塞尔的压力而改变贸易规则。

headlines.title_en: UK media reports: Britain resists EU pressure and refuses to impose tariffs on Chinese cars
headlines.summary_en: UK Secretary of State for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade Jonathan Reynolds rejected the EU's call for the UK to impose tariffs on Chinese goods. He said the UK government will not change its trade rules under pressure from Brussels.

headlines.title: 精准有效实施更加积极财政政策
headlines.summary: 2026年10月14日至16日，中国人民银行行长潘功胜在出席国际货币基金组织/世界银行年会期间，分别会见了泰国央行行长威泰、印尼央行行长德斯特里、马来西亚央行行长拉希德、印度央行行长马尔霍特拉、澳大利亚央行行长布洛克、土耳其央行行长卡拉汉、埃及央行行长阿卜杜拉、尼日利亚央行行长卡多索、格鲁吉亚央行行长特尔纳瓦等相关国家央行行长，就全球经济形势、深化双边务实金融合作等议题交换了意见。中国人民银行副行长宣昌能参加会见。（中国央行网站）

headlines.title: 富国银行：下周美国住房开工恐再降
headlines.summary: 富国银行在10月16日的前瞻中预计，美国9月住房开工将环比再降2.0%，年化总量降至125万套。数据将于下周二公布。该行指出，随着按揭利率持续上升，住房开工在过去五个月中已有四个月下降。9月底，按揭利率突破7%，购房负担进一步加重。美国全国住宅建筑商协会的调查显示，建商对未来销售的预期明显恶化，降价情况增多。多户住宅建设也受到融资成本上升、租金涨幅有限的拖累。建筑许可回落，则是该行预计9月开工继续下降的另一依据。

headlines.title_en: Wells Fargo: US housing starts may fall further next week
headlines.summary_en: Wells Fargo in its October 16 outlook forecast that US September housing starts will fall another 2.0% month on month to an annualized total of 1.25 million units. The data will be released next Tuesday. The bank noted that with mortgage rates continuing to rise, housing starts have fallen in four of the past five months. At the end of September, mortgage rates broke through 7%, further increasing the burden of home purchases. A survey by the National Association of Home Builders showed that builders' expectations for future sales have deteriorated markedly and price cuts have increased. Multifamily housing construction is also being weighed down by rising financing costs and limited rent growth. The decline in building permits is another basis for the bank's forecast that September starts will continue to fall.

headlines.title: 今年浙江义乌跨境电商进口清单量破1亿单
headlines.summary: 杭州海关所属义乌海关17日公布最新数据：截至10月17日，今年义乌海关监管的义乌跨境电商进口清单量突破1亿单，较去年达成该目标提前40余天，创同期历史新高。据悉，今年以来，义乌跨境电商进口商品涵盖食品、化妆品、婴幼儿奶粉、玩具等7万多个品类，来自全球90多个国家和地区。目前，义乌综合保税区和义乌保税物流中心集聚130多家跨境电商企业，今年前三季度跨境电商进口清单量达9605万单、货值237.79亿元人民币，分别同比增长25.1%和28.18%。（中国新闻网）

headlines.title_en: Yiwu, Zhejiang's cross-border e-commerce import manifest volume exceeds 100 million orders this year
headlines.summary_en: Yiwu Customs, under Hangzhou Customs, released the latest data on the 17th: as of October 17, the number of Yiwu cross-border e-commerce import lists supervised by Yiwu Customs this year exceeded 100 million, reaching the target more than 40 days earlier than last year and hitting a record high for the same period. It is reported that since the beginning of this year, Yiwu's cross-border e-commerce imported goods have covered more than 70,000 categories, including food, cosmetics, infant formula and toys, from more than 90 countries and regions around the world. Currently, the Yiwu Comprehensive Bonded Zone and the Yiwu Bonded Logistics Center have gathered more than 130 cross-border e-commerce companies. In the first three quarters of this year, the number of cross-border e-commerce import lists reached 96.05 million, with a value of 23.779 billion yuan, up 25.1% and 28.18% year on year, respectively. (China News Service)
